about: Shared byte-exact test vectors for hangar Mobile's Bluetooth link. Every binary value is lowercase hex. Strings are UTF-8.
token: the pairing token. psk = HKDF-SHA256(ikm: UTF-8 token, salt: empty, info: 'hangar-ble-psk', length 32).

serviceUUID: first 16 bytes of HMAC-SHA256(key: UTF-8 token, msg: 'hangar-ble-adv') with b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0F) | 0x40 and b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3F) | 0x80, written as a lowercase hyphenated UUID (compare case-insensitively). psmCharacteristicUUID is fixed; its value is the PSM as 2 bytes little-endian.

rotatingServiceUUIDs: the UUID the Mac advertises, which rotates every 15 minutes. epoch = floor(unix_seconds / 900); the UUID is derived as serviceUUID is, with msg 'hangar-ble-adv:' + decimal(epoch). The phone scans for epochs e-1, e, e+1. serviceUUID above is the unrotated form, kept for reference.

handshake: Noise_NNpsk0_25519_ChaChaPoly_SHA256, prologue ASCII 'hangar-ble-1', phone = initiator, Mac = responder, empty payloads. The *EphemeralPrivate fields are raw 32-byte X25519 PRIVATE keys; the *EphemeralPublic fields are their public keys. message1 = initiator e.pub (32) || 16-byte tag; message2 = responder e.pub (32) || 16-byte tag. handshakeHash is the final Noise h.

framing: every message on the L2CAP stream, handshake included, is u16 big-endian length || body. message1Wire is message1 framed that way. A rejection is one frame of length 1: 0x01 wrong key, 0x02 busy.

frames: transport messages in the order sent; each direction has its own counter, both starting at 0. Nonce = 4 zero bytes || u64 little-endian counter; associated data is empty. Split(): the first key carries phone-to-mac, the second mac-to-phone. plaintext is the line-stream chunk; deflated is its raw DEFLATE (RFC 1951, no zlib header) as Apple Compression produced it; frame = ChaChaPoly(deflated) = ciphertext || 16-byte tag. Deflate encoders differ in output bytes, so check encrypt(deflated) == frame, inflate(deflated) == plaintext and decrypt-then-inflate(frame) == plaintext; never compare your own deflate output with 'deflated'. encoder names who made 'deflated': apple-compression (Mac) or zlib (Python zlib.compressobj(wbits=-15) + flush(), as the phone's ZLibCodec(raw: true) does).

chunks: each plaintext chunk is 1...4096 bytes of the line stream, each frame independent; a longer line is split across frames. Each chunk is a complete raw DEFLATE stream ending with a final block (one-shot encode, not sync flush): Apple's inflate refuses a Z_SYNC_FLUSH chunk.

noiseConformance: the official cacophony vector for the same Noise protocol (different prologue and psk, non-empty payloads, plain Noise transport with no deflate). messages alternate initiator, responder, starting with message 1; messages[2...] are transport messages.
